subject: apps/api/src/registry/expect-pending.test.ts
because: paper.create and paper.duplicate became operation pairs whose Undo carries a guarded expectation, so the temporary exemption list it pinned is deleted with it. Its one unrelated case, an expectation that matches no field refuses the Undo, moved to expectation.formal.test.ts unchanged.

subject: apps/api/src/registry/registry.undo-later.formal.test.ts
because: paper.create and paper.duplicate no longer erase a later rename on Undo, so the known-violation list is empty and the test now requires that no command erases a later change. The check that each known violation sat on the exemption list goes with the deleted list.

subject: apps/api/src/paper/reset-paper.test.ts
because: paper.create now carries a guarded Undo. After the reset deletes the Paper, its receipt shows as not undoable and Undo is refused as a conflict instead of failing on a missing document; the test checks the new answers.
